headline: Quiet Linn Mercy Erupts Anew as Deadlands Battle Rages On
war_summary: The chief change since our last edition comes from Linn Mercy, listed quiet at the prior filing, where four base events inside two hours and casualty rates leaping from near nothing to roughly a hundred an hour a side mark a sudden flare; its eleven works stand nine Warden to two Colonial. The Deadlands remain the busiest field: two more base events in the past two hours, the latest a quarter-hour before this edition, nine in the day, and losses accelerating anew in the latest hour, with eight works Colonial to three Warden. Lykos Isle, freshest at last report, has gone still these two hours, its tally five Warden to two Colonial, and Fishermen's Row keeps its after-flurry silence. The Weathered Expanse continues its enormous hemorrhage, near twenty-four thousand colonial and twenty-three thousand warden casualties in a day and swelling again in the latest hour, though its nine works all remain in Warden keeping. Stlican Shelf, Loch Mor and Clahstra cool from their peaks, and Endless Shore is nearly still. Fifty-nine days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
